dod_intent_evidence: Genuine DoD motion exists (DARPA SBIR Phase II WHIRL $1.79M; $13.9M DARPA SMOKE cost-plus-fixed-fee award in news) — but they are a services/R&D contractor, not a product company: 'We're seasoned government contractors with the DNA of a tech startup' (homepage) and 'we've stacked our team... to deliver revolutionary solutions... for a range of federal government and intelligence clients' (about page). Business is winning and executing government research contracts; no product crossing the valley.
what_they_do: Small Arlington VA government R&D services contractor doing cyber, data science, and rapid prototyping for DARPA and intelligence-community clients.
